scenes.hook: JavaScript Arrays. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: An array stores an ordered collection of values. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: Array positions start at zero, so index zero gives the first item. Read the example from top to bottom.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw. Small changes in code can change the output.
scenes.tip: Push appends an item, and length reports the number of items. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: An array with three items has a last index of two. Understanding this helps you avoid a common beginner mistake.
scenes.try: Create an array of three skills and read its first item. Change one part, then compare your result.
scenes.close: Like, share, and subscribe for more web development basics.
